title: BPW-2026-0608
text:
[BUREAU OF SANITATION]
BPW-2026-0608
CD ALL
AMENDMENT NO. 1 – TASK ORDER SOLICITATION (TOS) B-004 – GEOSYNTEC CONSULTANTS INC. (GEOSYNTEC)
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE the Director and the General Manager of the Bureau of Sanitation or designee to issue Amendment Nol 1 to TOS B-004 to Geosyntec, including additional scope for soil sampling and targeted soil excavation and disposal prior to construction activities at future Spring Street crosswalk in Council District 1;
APPROVE a total budget of $271,300 (including $27,389 in contingency) to fund the services to conduct targeted soil removal and analysis in Council District 1 as part of the future Spring Street crosswalk. This increases the budget by $186,300 from $57,611 to $243,911; and
APPROVE the term of engagement beginning the Notice to Proceed to November 30, 2027 with 12-month optional extension.
(W.O: S06YB004, C-202382)
